comingLast.roast: dead level with Forsyth in the race to the bottom - a photo finish nobody framed
escape number: 3. holes remaining: 2. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
on 18 - every one of his remaining 4 holes is now appointment viewing
on 21 with 2 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
4 more points and the problem becomes Pollock's problem
tied for last with Pollock - one of them buys, both of them stay
1 point clear from the bar - watching Pollock like a hawk with a beer
safe by 1 - unless Pollock finds form, in which case, gulp
safe by 2 - unless Pollock finds form, in which case, gulp
2 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
